error[ZBX-E0427]: the container is still running
  cause  'web-1' is still running, and zbx does not freeze a running container
  fix    stop it, then commit:   zbx stop web-1
  more   zbx explain E0427 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0427.html
